verdict.rationale: Lambda's pricing page offers reserved capacity "at our lowest prices" through sales contact. The console has a "Reserve 1-Click Cluster" flow, and Private Cloud provides dedicated single-tenant 1,000+ GPU clusters, so discounted committed capacity exists. However, it is sales-gated, and no commitment terms, discount levels or self-serve purchase of committed-use pricing are documented. missing for 10: documented commitment terms and discount tiers, self-serve or API-driven purchase of reserved pricing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
